$Comment: The gameplay of zc's dungeon template: the game's Default_Instance (no block breaking or gathering, no world events) with block placing switched off too, so nobody builds in a dungeon and every area pastes back clean for the next party; and a player who dies respawns at the world's spawn provider, which puts each player back in their own area. Default_Instance itself sends the dead out of the instance. A dungeon whose template names another gameplay config keeps that one's rules.
